fact: Article 35 of Loi L/2019/0056/AN of 30 December 2019 says credit bureau data, databases and backup sites may be moved to or kept in a foreign state only with the BCRG's prior authorisation, and the BCRG, as supervisor, may sanction and order corrective measures.
title: Loi L/2019/0056/AN relative aux Bureaux d'Information sur le crédit
